metadata.title: Acme Health Patient Intake API - GRC component

components.title: Patient Intake API
components.description: The deployed Acme Health Patient Intake API: API Gateway HTTP API, Lambda handler, DynamoDB submissions table, and S3 uploads bucket, hardened against the 8 gaps in GAPS.md and continuously checked by the grc-gate pipeline on every push.
components.purpose: Accept patient intake submissions and store them in a way that is defensible against a CMMC Level 2 audit.

control-implementations.description: CMMC Level 2 practices implemented by this repository's Terraform and OPA policies, one implemented-requirement per gap in GAPS.md. See WRITEUP.md's Control coverage table for the full commit history behind each one.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-01: the uploads bucket is encrypted with aws:kms using a customer-managed CMK (terraform/kms.tf's aws_kms_key.phi), not the AWS-managed SSE-S3 default. Enforced continuously by policies/gap01_s3_kms.rego, which fails the gate if the SSE config is removed or reverted to AES256.

links.text: Signed grc-gate pipeline bundle for the run that applied this control to production (commit 5e20b28, policy gap01_s3_kms.rego added in 808d48a). Verify with scripts/verify-evidence.sh 34024978457.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-02: the submissions table's server_side_encryption block uses the same customer-managed CMK, not the AWS-owned default. Enforced continuously by policies/gap02_dynamodb_kms.rego.

links.text: Signed grc-gate pipeline bundle for the run that applied this control to production (commit d2aacfa, policy gap02_dynamodb_kms.rego added in 808d48a). Verify with scripts/verify-evidence.sh 34024978457.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-03: the uploads bucket has a policy denying any request where aws:SecureTransport is false. Terraform-only; not independently re-verified in policy because its content lives inside a jsonencode()'d policy document Terraform's plan JSON doesn't expose as a flat string (see WRITEUP.md Notes).

links.text: Signed grc-gate pipeline bundle for the run that applied this control to production (commit 6919a6e). Verify with scripts/verify-evidence.sh 34024978457.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-04: versioning is enabled on the uploads bucket so PHI overwrites and deletes are recoverable. Enforced continuously by policies/gap04_s3_versioning.rego, which generalizes to every aws_s3_bucket in the plan and caught a real gap on the CloudTrail bucket before this component was ever written.

links.text: Signed grc-gate pipeline bundle for the run that applied this control to production (commit 33c00d2, policy gap04_s3_versioning.rego added in 808d48a). Verify with scripts/verify-evidence.sh 34024978457.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-05: the intake Lambda runs inside the starter's existing private VPC subnets with a scoped security group, reaching DynamoDB, S3, and KMS only via VPC endpoints rather than the public internet. Enforced continuously by policies/gap05_lambda_vpc.rego as an existence check on vpc_config.

links.text: Signed grc-gate pipeline bundle for the run that applied this control to production (commit 2774c97, policy gap05_lambda_vpc.rego added in 808d48a). Verify with scripts/verify-evidence.sh 34024978457.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-06: a dead-letter queue and X-Ray tracing were added to the intake Lambda. Marked partial, not implemented: the DLQ only catches asynchronous-invocation failures and this Lambda is invoked synchronously by API Gateway, and reserved concurrency could not be set at all against this account's 10-execution Lambda quota (see WRITEUP.md Notes). Not enforced in policy given its own partial nature.

links.text: Signed grc-gate pipeline bundle for the run that applied this control to production (commit b60bd72). Verify with scripts/verify-evidence.sh 34024978457.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-07: the Lambda's inline IAM policy is scoped to exactly dynamodb:PutItem and s3:PutObject, down from the starter's dynamodb:*/s3:*. Enforced continuously by policies/gap07_lambda_least_priv.rego, which regex-checks the planned policy document for any service:* wildcard action and confirmed blocking a real reintroduction of this gap in PR #2 (CI run 34025487183).

links.text: Signed grc-gate pipeline bundle for the run that applied this control to production (commit c8c7d13, policy gap07_lambda_least_priv.rego added in 808d48a). Verify with scripts/verify-evidence.sh 34024978457.

implemented-requirements.description: GAP-08: the API Gateway stage has access logging and throttling, writing to a CloudWatch log group encrypted with the same customer CMK and scoped with an aws:SourceArn condition against confused-deputy access. WAF was not attached: WAFv2 does not support HTTP APIs as an association target at all (see WRITEUP.md Notes). Logging/throttling existence enforced continuously by policies/gap08_apigw_logging.rego; WAF has no policy check since it was never built.

links.text: Signed grc-gate pipeline bundle for the run that applied this control to production (commits 2c3fe52, 7ed5d48, policy gap08_apigw_logging.rego added in 808d48a). Verify with scripts/verify-evidence.sh 34024978457.
